hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx eslint "$f" --fix 2>/dev/null; npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; done || true
echo '{"systemMessage": "📋 开发工作流: 编码 → 测试(npm test) → 类型检查(npm run typecheck) → 文档 → 提交。Ctrl+Shift+B 一键验证。"}' 2>/dev/null || true
echo '{"systemMessage": "💡 别忘了执行完整验证: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint"}' 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)' && echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  提交前请先运行验证: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint"}' || true
